items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin clean without stripping or adding irritation.
A simple barrier moisturizer supports comfort, since your moisture score is on the lower side.
A mineral SPF 50 helps keep the marks left behind from looking darker in the sun.

response.routine_note: Deep, painful lumps along the jaw that leave marks are best looked at by a dermatologist, so I've held back the 5% benzoyl peroxide wash and the 30% peel, which are likely to irritate skin that is already sore. Use the cleanser morning and night, then moisturizer, and finish with SPF in the morning.
